summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing routine updates to its at-the-market (ATM) offering program and bitcoin holdings. During the period April 13-19, 2026, it sold 21,795,389 shares of STRC Preferred Stock (notional $2.18B, net $2.18B) and 2,165,000 shares of MSTR common stock (net $366M), with remaining capacity of $19.5B and $26.7B respectively. It also acquired 34,164 BTC for $2.54B at avg $74,395, bringing total holdings to 815,061 BTC ($61.56B cost basis, avg $75,527). These ongoing sales and purchases represent ordinary capital-raising and treasury management, not a discrete special-situation event.
